_comment: plan-faction-flips chunk 2 (D7): the disengage cooldown. Puts every wildlife mob in range out of combat until it is attacked — it drops its current target, acquires nothing, and its aura gates off. It does NOT flip faction: a calmed wolf is still a wolf anyone can damage, it has simply stopped swinging. ANY damage breaks it, INCLUDING the caster's own damage aura (PO 2026-07-28) — calm means 'stop this fight so I can leave', not 'hold this one while I kill that one'. targetFactions is the D8 allowlist: authored names, resolved to a faction bitmask at content load, so widening the scope is a content edit and not a code change. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
